name: xerj
description: XERJ: the search engine for AI agents. One local Rust binary that indexes your code, docs, specs and logs, plus Corpus Hub packs, and returns cited answers.
long_description:
A new way for AI to search for data: one local Rust binary that indexes your code, docs, specs and logs, plus Corpus Hub packs, and returns cited answers.

This bundle runs `xerj mcp`, a stdio MCP server that proxies search, memory, code-map and Corpus Hub tools to a XERJ node. Start a node first with `xerj --insecure --data-dir ~/xerj-data` (install: https://xerj.org/docs/install), or point XERJ URL at a node you already run. The Corpus Hub tools work without a local index.

xerj_url.title: XERJ node URL
xerj_url.description: ES-compatible listener of a running XERJ node.

xerj_auth.title: Authorization header
xerj_auth.description: For a node with auth on, for example 'ApiKey <key>'. Leave empty for a loopback node: the key is read from <data-dir>/admin.key.
